snippet.title: Spirit Of The North 2 - Official Development Deep Dive Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Watch the Development Deep Dive Trailer for Spirit Of The North 2, an adventure exploration game developed by Infuse Studio. Players can get a behind-the-scenes look at how the team upgraded the iconic original with modern mechanics, enhanced visuals, and expanded lore. Includes side-by-side comparisons, developer commentary, and insights into reimagining a classic for a new generation. Spirit Of The North 2 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
